description: Official gross monthly salaries in Switzerland by ECONOMIC SECTOR (BFS Swiss Earnings Structure Survey LSE): median and P10/P25/P75/P90 for all employees, women and men, by major region. canton (2-letter) is mapped to its major region; sector = NOGA code or words («banking», «software»). For salaries by OCCUPATION and age (nurse, developer, teacher) use salary_by_occupation.

canton.description: Canton as 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. "ZH", "GE", "TI". Mapped to its BFS major region.

region.description: major region code 1–7 or -1 for Switzerland

sector.description: Economic sector as NOGA code or words, e.g. "64", "banking", "software", "construction"; omit for all sectors.

year.description: Year of the earnings survey (every two years: 2012 to 2024), e.g. 2026; omit for the latest. An unavailable year returns the list of available years.

name: get_salary
title: Salaries by sector
